answer: Assume the attacker reads the rules first. Reciprocity-weighted attestation means votes count in proportion to what the voter has given, so a farm that only takes casts near-zero weight no matter how many accounts it runs. Rewards convert to a slow vesting stream, which keeps a stolen jade in the harbor long after the theft. Quorum must span unrelated subnetworks, so a private ledge of accounts cannot outvote honest peers. Breaking this costs sustained contribution, not capital.
